variants.name: XL, 2 pcs., black
variants.about_this_item:
• with all-round robust anti-slip rubber coating for secure hold even if the socks should slip
  • especially suitable for older dogs
  • cotton with elasthane/latex
  • colour: black

Non-slip socks for your dog On slippery floors, such as laminate or tiles, dogs often slip or have trouble getting up. Especially older dogs have difficulties on slippery surfaces. This is where our non-slip dog socks come to the rescue - thanks to the robust and generous anti-slip rubber coating at the front of the socks, your dog has a secure grip. The socks can also be used to protect minor wounds. Wearing the socks prevents dirt from getting into the wound and keeps your dog from licking the wound. Additionally, the anti-slip socks protect floors and furniture from damage caused by your dog's claws. The socks come in six sizes and can be washed at 30 degrees in the washing machine.
